		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "COLDWAR_CMEA_toolbar_window"
		dirty = global.cwcm_dirty
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		visible = { is_ai = no

		effects = {
			COLDWAR_CMEA_open_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_open }
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_open
					remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_viewers = THIS }
				}
				else = {
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_open
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_viewers value = THIS } } }
						add_to_array = { global.cwcm_viewers = THIS }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_tab < 1 } }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_tab = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_cv = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_chap = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_mode = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_size = 2 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_type = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ret = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_prog = 101 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_popt = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_ptier = 2 }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ui_major = 141 }
					}
					COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_global = yes
					COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_refresh = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
			}
		}

			COLDWAR_CMEA_open = { x = global.var_missiles_button_x }

					COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_rat_parliament = yes
				}

					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 2 } }

				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_rslot = 4 } }

	COLDWAR_CMEA_sessmode = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "COLDWAR_CMEA_sessmode_window"
		parent_scripted_gui = COLDWAR_CMEA_main
		dirty = global.cwcm_dirty
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		visible = { is_ai = no
			check_variable = { cwcm_ui_tab = 1 } }
		effects = {
			ec_sm_1_click = {
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_cv = 1 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_refresh = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
			}
			ec_sm_2_click = {
				set_variable = { cwcm_ui_cv = 2 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_refresh = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
			}
		}
		properties = {
			ec_sm_1 = { frame = cwcm_ui_cvf1 }
			ec_sm_2 = { frame = cwcm_ui_cvf2 }
		}
	}

	COLDWAR_CMEA_desk = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "COLDWAR_CMEA_desk_window"
		parent_scripted_gui = COLDWAR_CMEA_main
		dirty = global.cwcm_dirty
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		visible = { is_ai = no
			check_variable = { cwcm_ui_tab = 1 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_ui_ndesk > 0 } }
		effects = {
			ec_dp_prev_click = {
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_dpage = -1 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_refresh = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
			}
			ec_dp_next_click = {
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_ui_dpage = 1 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_ui_refresh = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
			}
			ec_d_b1_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 1 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_rat_parliament = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 21 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_accept = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 41 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 1 }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_table_now = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 2 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_rat_parliament = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 22 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_accept = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 42 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 2 }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_table_now = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 3 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_rat_parliament = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 23 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_accept = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 43 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 3 }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_table_now = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 4 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_rat_parliament = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 24 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_accept = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 44 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 4 }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_table_now = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 5 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_rat_parliament = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 25 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_accept = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 45 } }

					COLDWAR_CMEA_table_now = yes
				}
				else_if = {

				}

					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 21 } }

				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 27 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_decline = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 47 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 7 }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_decline_draft = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 8 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_rat_refuse = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 28 } }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_decline = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 48 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 8 }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_decline_draft = yes
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
			}
		}
		triggers = {
			ec_dp_prev_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { cwcm_ui_dpage > 0 }
			}
			ec_dp_next_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { cwcm_ui_dpage1 < cwcm_ui_dpages }
			}
			ec_dp_prev_visible = {
				check_variable = { cwcm_ui_dpages > 1 }
			}
			ec_dp_page_visible = {
				check_variable = { cwcm_ui_dpages > 1 }
			}
			ec_dp_next_visible = {

			}
			ec_d_b1_click_enabled = {

					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 1 } COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 2 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 1 } has_political_power > 24.99 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 22 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 7 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target = ROOT.id } }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 42 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 1 } COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 3 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 1 } has_political_power > 24.99 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 23 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 7 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target = ROOT.id } }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 43 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 1 } COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 4 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_4 = 1 } has_political_power > 24.99 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 24 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 7 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_target = ROOT.id } }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 44 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 1 } COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }

					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 45 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 1 } COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 6 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_6 = 1 } has_political_power > 24.99 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 26 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 7 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_target = ROOT.id } }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 46 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 1 } COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 7 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 1 } has_political_power > 24.99 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 27 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 7 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_target = ROOT.id } }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 47 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 1 } COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }

					OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 61 } check_variable = { cwcm_ui_d1 = 62 } }

				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }

				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_target = 0 }

				add_political_power = -50
				COLDWAR_CMEA_submit_application = yes
				COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
			}
			ec_ac_leave_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_leaving }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_withdraw_notice = yes
				}
				else = {
					COLDWAR_CMEA_give_notice = yes
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
			}
			ec_ac_ec_click = {
